summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K announcing the early redemption of its GBP 300 million subordinated Tier 2 notes (ISIN XS2206805769), effective July 15, 2026, at GBP 100,000 per note plus accrued interest of GBP 3,104 per note. The redemption follows ECB authorization and is a routine capital management transaction, not a special situation. No price premium, share exchange, or strategic change is involved. The filing is a standard debt redemption notice, equivalent to a US notice of optional redemption. No deal terms apply.
